candidates.content_text:
Work in CAD every day on some of the most capable pipe profiling equipment in the country.
Waypoint  is partnering with Surepipe to appoint a CAD Draftsperson / Estimator supporting the growth of their steel pipe processing and profiling capability.
Surepipe is a privately owned steel pipe supply and processing business working exclusively in carbon steel, servicing the mining, drilling and minerals, structural, pressure vessel and general industrial markets across Australia and the Pacific.
Their point of difference is the profiling. The equipment is European-built and among the most capable of its type in the country, the same class of machine used to profile structural pipework for major stadium projects overseas. It allows Surepipe to add real value to a length of pipe before it reaches a customer's workshop, delivering ready-to-weld product and a genuine efficiency gain for fabricators.
The role
You'll be working in CAD daily. Checking and interpreting customer drawings, making modifications, adding weld preparation detail, and getting drawings out to the profiler so the operators can keep running.
You'll also translate customer concepts and sketches into CAD models, taking an idea through to something that can be priced and cut. Research and development work sits here too, turning concept sketches into models for new products and accessories.
Alongside the CAD, you'll prepare estimates from customer drawings and specifications, with enough detail that the customer service team can run with them. Speed matters, and turning enquiries around the same or next business day is a real competitive advantage.
You'll manage scheduling across the processing function, balancing customer expectations against machine capacity, and provide technical support to the internal sales team and the Business Development Managers on tenders.
Who will you be working with?
You'll report to the manager who leads the processing function, who has a fabrication and engineering background and will back you while you find your feet.
You'll sit alongside a minerals and resources team leader, internal sales team members, Business Development Managers, and the operations team.
What is on offer
 - Competitive base salary plus super
 - Quarterly bonus available after probation. It applies to every team member and is based purely on revenue and gross profit
 - Laptop and CAD workstation provided
 - Quarterly check-ins and a full annual review. The business actively supports further study
 - Genuine progression as the processing capability grows, either toward leading a processing department or toward estimating and project management
 - Varied work, from small fabrication jobs through to multi-million dollar packages, including major infrastructure and public art works across Australia and into the Pacific regions
What Surepipe is looking for
 - Operational CAD capability. You'll be working in drawings every day, building and modifying models rather than just reading them. Surepipe currently uses Fusion 360 and ProCAM but isn't locked into a platform
 - Some exposure to estimating or quoting. You don't need years of it, but you should be comfortable taking a set of drawings and working toward a number
 - A TAFE diploma or similar two-year qualification in engineering or drafting. Degree-qualified candidates are welcome but it's not required
 - Exposure to CAM or machine programming is an advantage
 - An understanding of Australian Standards for steel is an advantage, though it can be taught
 - Genuinely detail-oriented, and disciplined enough to check rather than assume
 - Outgoing, communicative and collaborative. This role sits in the middle of the business and you'll be working closely with the team every day
 - Strong written and spoken English
 Early-career candidates are genuinely encouraged to apply. If you've got the CAD capability and some quoting exposure, Surepipe will back you to grow into the rest. The business actively supports further study, and candidates still completing a qualification will be considered.
Backgrounds of interest include steel processing and distribution, laser cutting and profiling, structural steel fabrication, and pipe or tube supply.
Location and working arrangements
Fully site based in Brendale, and you'll spend time in the workshop and on the machine to stay familiar with the capability.
Interested?
Apply with your CV, or contact Sam O'Brien at sam@waypointconsulting.com.au for a confidential conversation.
candidates.teaser: CAD and estimating role with a growing steel pipe processing business. Work on some of the most capable profiling equipment in the country.

From complex stormwater drainage networks to comprehensive road upgrades spanning urban centers and rural landscapes, you'll master diverse engineering disciplines while building a portfolio of high-impact projects that showcase your growing expertise. - Demonstrated ability to use survey equipment including GNSS rovers, digital levels, total stations and ground 
penetrating radar

Ready to find more from work and life?
Join us and help strengthen our community and your career.
This position offers an attractive annual salary ranging from $100,399 to $116,679 plus 3.5 % Civil Liabilities Allowance & Superannuation.
To find out more about this role, explore the Position Description and feel free to reach out to our Engineering Design Team Leader on 02 6801 6411 to make an enquiry.

Applications close 9:00am, Monday 19th October 2026

Everything you do at Dubbo Regional Council makes a difference for so many people, in so many ways. It'll always be that way. - Want to help us better the communities we live and work in? Our purpose of creating, connecting, and caring for communities is more than a saying to us - it's a way of thinking, working, and living because we're locals too, and seek to give back in ways that strengthen and build resilient communities. We do this because we genuinely care, enjoy what we do, and even manage to have some fun along the way! You'll find us partnering with local and national community groups, like Clontarf Foundation, Black Dog Institute, and Soldier On, in addition to indigenous groups and social enterprises, to ensure that our good work positively impacts and brings about sustainable change within our industry.

What's on offer?
With continued growth we are looking to appoint a Junior Estimator to join our Infrastructure Services business in Mile End, SA. Our people share the same set of values that keep us REAL. Respect, Energy and Effort, Attitude and Leadership encapsulate what we stand for at Fulton Hogan and encourage us to foster a diverse and inclusive culture where we listen to, care for, celebrate, and respect everyone. If our values resonate with you, please submit an application for the position. If you're not sure that you meet 100% of the selection criteria, that's okay, we would still like to hear from you and potentially discuss how your skills could be utilised at Fulton Hogan.

candidates.content_text:
Come join the Norweld team!
• Bring Australian-made products to life from concept through to production
• Hands-on SolidWorks role across design, prototyping and manufacturing
• Cairns preferred, with Brisbane-based applicants also considered
WHO WE ARE
For over 50 years, Norweld has been making our customers’ dreams a reality. Through extensive research and development at our head office in Cairns, we have built a world-class reputation for delivering the ultimate tray and canopy packages. Designed and manufactured in Australia, we use the highest-grade materials and cutting-edge manufacturing techniques to build the toughest products in the country.
We pride ourselves on offering a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace – one where we have fun, work as a team, deliver the ultimate customer experience and enjoy rewarding careers. Come and join the Norweld family!
THE OPPORTUNITY
Norweld is seeking a practical and detail-focused Draftsperson / Industrial Designer to support the development of our vehicle tray, canopy and accessory range. Working closely with Engineering, tradespeople and Manufacturing, you will develop accurate SolidWorks models, detailed drawings and production-ready designs. The role supports products from initial concept and prototype through testing, review and approved production release.
This is not a purely desk-based drafting role. You will spend time with the people manufacturing and assembling our products, participate in practical prototyping and trials and help resolve design, fit and manufacturing issues. The position is preferably based at our Cairns head office. However, applications from suitably experienced Brisbane-based candidates will also be considered.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Developing new and improved products, components and design solutions from concept through to production release
• Creating and modifying SolidWorks parts, assemblies and manufacturing drawings, including configurations, sheet-metal components and weldments
• Producing accurate technical drawings, bills of materials, specifications and supporting manufacturing information
• Applying mechanical design principles, appropriate tolerances and knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes
• Designing for sheet-metal fabrication, machining, welding, assembly, installation, serviceability and repeatable production
• Completing design checks to confirm dimensions, fit, clearances, interfaces, tolerances and functionality
• Participating in hands-on prototype fabrication, assembly, fitment, product trials and testing
• Working with Engineering, tradespeople and Manufacturing to identify and resolve design and production issues
• Supporting the controlled introduction of new and changed products into production
• Maintaining accurate models, drawings, revisions and technical information through approved review, change and release processes
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
The successful candidate will combine strong design and drafting skills with practical mechanical thinking. You will enjoy seeing your work become a physical product and be comfortable seeking input from the people responsible for manufacturing, assembling and installing it.
Hands-on fabrication, prototyping, assembly or vehicle fitment experience would be highly regarded, together with experience in automotive, vehicle accessories, aluminium fabrication or low-volume manufacturing.
The ideal candidate will have:
• Approximately three to five years’ experience in industrial design, drafting, mechanical design or a related design and manufacturing role
• Demonstrated SolidWorks capability across assemblies, configurations, sheet metal and weldments
• Experience designing for sheet-metal fabrication, machining, welding and other manufacturing processes
• A sound understanding of mechanical design principles, materials and manufacturing processes
• Strong problem-solving ability, mechanical aptitude and attention to detail
• A disciplined approach to design control, document management, approvals and production-release processes
• The ability to work independently, manage priorities and contribute effectively within a multidisciplinary team
• A relevant qualification in industrial design, mechanical drafting, engineering design or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience

• Client, contractor and stakeholder management
• Project reporting and documentation
• Assisting with variations and other commercial aspects of projects
• Identifying and resolving issues throughout project delivery

You will be organised, confident dealing with different stakeholders and comfortable moving between technical requirements, site operations and project coordination.
Ideally, you will have:
• Previous Project Engineer experience within civil construction
• Relevant engineering qualifications
• Strong QA and project documentation experience
• Experience managing project programs and timeframes
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
• The ability to develop effective working relationships with site Supervisors
• Good commercial awareness
• A practical approach to problem solving and project delivery
Why DCS Civil?
This is not a role where you will be sitting on the sidelines of project delivery. You will work closely with the Directors of the business and have genuine involvement in how projects are planned, coordinated and delivered.
DCS Civil undertakes a range of civil works, including niche and specialised projects that provide plenty of variety and exposure.
Importantly, this is a Hobart based role. You can continue building your career in civil construction while being home every night and maintaining a genuine work life balance.
A competitive salary package is on offer, together with either a company vehicle or vehicle allowance.
If you are an experienced Project Engineer looking for a Hobart based role with variety, responsibility and the opportunity to work closely with the people making the decisions, we would love to hear from you.
All applications are to be submitted via SEEK.
Confidential expressions of interest or enquiries can be directed to Jason Reed at jreed@talentadvisory.com.au.
All enquiries and applications will be treated in confidence.

candidates.content_text:
Why Norton?
At Norton, you won’t just be producing drawings that disappear into a folder. You’ll help turn customer ideas, site information and practical farming requirements into livestock handling solutions that are built, installed and put to work.
Based in Hastings, Victoria, Norton is an established Australian manufacturer of livestock handling equipment, farm gates and yard solutions. As part of the Gallagher family, we combine local manufacturing expertise with the resources and reach of a global organisation.
You’ll work closely with Sales, Operations and Manufacturing, giving you the opportunity to see projects through from the initial concept right through to production and installation.
You’ll also enjoy a varied role, plenty of opportunity to build your technical and industry knowledge, and a practical, down-to-earth team environment.
The Opportunity
As our CAD Draftsperson, you’ll turn customer requirements and site information into practical, manufacturable livestock handling solutions.
You’ll create yard layouts, scaled aerial site plans and concept designs using customer requirements, site measurements, survey information and drone imagery. From there, you’ll develop detailed 2D and 3D CAD models, fabrication drawings, assembly documentation and bills of materials ready for production.
Working across Sales, Operations and Manufacturing, you’ll help make sure designs are practical, cost-effective, accurate and fit for purpose.
You’ll be responsible for
- Creating customer sales plans, yard layouts and scaled site plans
- Designing cattle and sheep yards that support safe, efficient livestock flow
- Producing detailed 2D and 3D CAD models and fabrication drawings
- Preparing component, assembly and sub-assembly documentation
- Developing accurate bills of materials and component schedules
- Managing drawing revisions and maintaining drafting standards
- Working with internal teams to solve design and manufacturing challenges
The Fit
You’re a practical, detail-focused CAD professional who enjoys taking an idea and figuring out how to make it work.
You’ll bring:
- A qualification in engineering drafting, mechanical design or a related discipline
- Experience with SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, AutoCAD, Fusion 360 or similar
- Experience producing 2D and 3D drawings in manufacturing, fabrication or engineering
- Knowledge of fabrication drawings, BOMs and assembly documentation
- An understanding of steel fabrication, welding and manufacturing processes
- Strong spatial awareness, accuracy and problem-solving skills
- Experience with livestock handling equipment, agricultural manufacturing, rural infrastructure, aerial mapping or survey data would be a bonus.
If you want a CAD role where your work gets out of the computer and into the real world, we’d love to hear from you.
Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.

About the role
Cathay Chung Yue Estate Pty Ltd is seeking a talented Graduate Engineer to join our Civil/Structural Engineering team. This is an exciting opportunity to launch your engineering career with a dynamic organisation based in Rhodes NSW. As a full-time position, you will be working on-site as we develop the next generation of engineers within our growing business. Key responsibilities
·         Assist with preparation of cost estimates, quotations and tender submissions.
·         Review architectural, structural and façade drawings, specifications and other tender documentation.
·         Undertake quantity take-offs and material measurements from drawings and project documents.
·         Obtain and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations and assist with cost analysis.
·         Maintain and update estimating spreadsheets, cost databases and pricing records.
·         Assist with identifying scope gaps, discrepancies, exclusions and design changes during the estimating process.
·         Maintain an organised document control system for drawings, specifications, RFIs, submissions, correspondence and other project documentation.
·         Track drawing revisions and ensure the latest approved documents are readily available to relevant personnel.
·         Assist project teams with preparation and issue of transmittals, registers and document submissions.
·         Maintain tender and project registers, including drawing, RFI, quotation and procurement registers.
·         Liaise with suppliers, subcontractors, consultants and internal project personnel to obtain required information.
·         Assist with preparation of variation and cost assessment documentation when required.
·         Support the Operation Manager and Estimating Manager with general technical and commercial administration.
Required Qualifications & Skills
·         Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Construction or related Engineering.
·         0–2 years' experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
·         Good understanding of engineering drawings and construction documentation.
·         Strong Microsoft Excel skills and ability to work with spreadsheets and cost data.
·         Familiarity with AutoCAD or similar drawing software would be advantageous.
·         Strong attention to detail and document management skills.
·         Good numerical, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
·         Good written and verbal communication skills.
·         Ability to work independently while also supporting a project team.
·         Strong willingness to learn construction, façade and estimating practices.
Desirable
·         Previous internship or graduate experience in the construction or façade industry.
·         Understanding of Australian construction documentation and tender processes.
·         Experience with document control systems such as Aconex, Procore or similar platforms.
·         Basic understanding of façade systems, cladding, windows and building construction would be highly regarded.
·  Work Arrangement: Primarily office-based, with occasional site visits as required.
What we're looking for
·  A relevant degree qualification in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline
·  Recent graduate or early-career engineer with limited professional experience
·  Strong knowledge of civil and structural engineering principles, theories and practices
·  Proficiency with computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering analysis tools
·  Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in technical work
·  Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
·  Effective communication skills with the ability to present technical information clearly
·  A collaborative approach to working within teams and willingness to learn from experienced professionals
·  Knowledge of Australian Building Standards (AS/NZS) and relevant engineering codes an advantage
·  A current or eligible Professional Engineer in Training (PE) status, or willingness to pursue this qualification
·  Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and technical documentation software
What we offer
At Cathay Chung Yue Estate Pty Ltd, we are committed to fostering a supportive environment where graduates can thrive and develop into skilled professionals. We offer structured mentoring and guidance from experienced engineers to support your professional development. Our team values continuous learning, and we encourage staff to undertake further qualifications and professional development. We provide a competitive salary package commensurate with experience, and we are committed to maintaining a safe, inclusive and collaborative workplace culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements where possible to support employee wellbeing.
About us
Cathay Chung Yue Estate Pty Ltd is a progressive organisation working in the civil and structural engineering sector. We are committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions that contribute to the built environment across New South Wales. With a focus on innovation, sustainability and professional excellence, we work on diverse projects that challenge and develop our team. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, where every team member's contribution is valued, and we invest in the development of our people to ensure both personal and organisational success.
Apply now

Please submit your CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter outlining your interest in this role to Cathay Chung Yue Estate Pty Ltd. We look forward to receiving your application.

Join a team that believes solving problems is their calling.Based in Brisbane, this is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Structural Designer / Drafter to join us at HK Solutions, a growing national engineering consultancy where your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of structural projects across Australia.
You’ll take ownership of the drawing and documentation package on your projects, working closely with structural engineers and project managers to take designs from concept through to construction. This isn’t a role where you’ll simply be picking up redlines - you’ll be trusted to manage the drafting and modelling requirements of your projects, contribute your technical knowledge, and have genuine input into how structural solutions are developed and documented.
We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, take on greater responsibility and continue building their capability over time.
ABOUT HK SOLUTIONS (HKS)
HKS is a growing national engineering consultancy with a reputation for practical client-focused solutions that make a real impact. 
Our team is known for being technically capable, commercially minded and easy to work with. We’re proud of the work we do, but just as importantly, we’re proud of the culture we’ve built. We value mutual respect, humility, genuine teamwork and a healthy dose of fun along the way.
As we continue to grow, we’re focused on developing great people, building strong teams and creating opportunities for our team members to contribute, learn and thrive.
If you're looking for a workplace where your ideas are valued and your contribution genuinely matters, we’d love to hear from you.
THE ROLE
Working as part of our structural engineering team and based in Brisbane, you will work with engineers to develop coordinated documentation, for the delivery of high-quality structural projects. Your day-to-day work will typically include:
- Preparing detailed structural documentation and drawings using Revit 3D and AutoCAD
- Assisting with technical inspections and preparation of supporting documentation and reports
- Supporting the development and standardisation of drafting systems
- Contributing to smooth project delivery in collaboration with the broader team
- Interacting with our broader team for successful project delivery
- Bringing fresh ideas and technical creativity to our national structural engineering group
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In your first 12 months, you'll:
- Become a trusted member of our structures engineering team
- Deliver accurate, high-quality design documentation across multiple projects
- Build strong relationships with clients, contractors and internal stakeholders
- Contribute ideas that improve project outcomes and team efficiency
- Be trusted to run the drafting on your own projects with genuine autonomy 
ABOUT YOU
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical capability with a proactive and collaborative approach. You'll ideally bring:
- Solid experience in structural design drafting and modelling 
- Strong proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD
- Knowledge of the practical application of NCC and Australian Standards relevant to structural construction
- Experience assisting with construction inspections and structural condition assessments is desirable
- A proactive mindset and willingness to contribute to process improvement
- Keen attention to detail, with excellent communication skills
- Flexibility to work independently or as part of a collaborative team
- Alignment with our company values, with a desire to contribute to a positive team culture
Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys working with others, takes pride in producing quality work and wants to contribute to a growing business.
WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING HERE
At HKS, we understand that great people build great businesses. That's why we focus on creating an environment where our employees feel supported, trusted and valued. Our people enjoy:
- A supportive, collaborative and genuinely welcoming team culture
- Flexible and family-friendly working arrangements
- Profit-sharing opportunities when the business succeeds
- Additional paid company-wide leave days each year
- Paid volunteer leave to support causes that matter to you
- Interstate office exchange opportunities
- Opportunities for professional development and career growth as the business continues to expand
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
READY FOR THE NEXT STEP?
If you're looking to join a growing consultancy where you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

In this role you will make an impact and gain experience in the following ways:

- Produce detailed engineering drawings and documentation for manufacturing release.

- Are currently studying a degree in Mechanical, Mechatronic or Product Engineering, ideally in your 3rd or 4th year of study
- Have between 1 and 8 units of study left to complete of your undergraduate degree as of January 2027
- Ideally completed the penultimate year with one final year of university left before graduation.

To be successful in this role, you will possess skills/abilities or be able to perform:
- Strong academic results in Mathematics; Thermodynamics; Mechanical Design; Professional Practice.
- Drafting or CAD modelling skills (Solidworks, CREO, Inventor or AutoCAD).
- Excellent analytical skills and strong attention to detail.
- Understanding of product lifecycle management principles
- Some project management skills.
- Clear communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Strong computer literacy and a solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite.
- Outstanding interpersonal skills, a team work ethic and the ability to think and operate autonomously and independently when required.
- Knowledge of internal combustion engines is highly desirable
This is a 13-month, full time or part time, paid placement and the successful candidate will be required to defer their studies for the duration of the program.

candidates.content_text:
Join Roam Engineering and help deliver critical power and telecommunications infrastructure
We are hiring a Structural Project Engineer to join our team.
About Roam Engineering
Roam Engineering is a family-owned Western Australian company with a strong reputation for delivering quality projects. We design, supply and construct steel structures for the power transmission and telecommunications sectors, including steel poles, lattice towers and guyed masts, together with their foundations. In-house design, fabrication and construction capability, gives us control over every stage of delivery.
The role
As a Project Engineer you will support Project Managers coordinate project delivery from design through fabrication to construction. You will start by supporting Project Managers on larger projects and progressively take full ownership of small to mid-sized projects. We are looking for someone who wants to progress on a Project Management career path and is ready to work towards it.
Key responsibilities
- Review scope of works for tenders and projects, and help develop delivery methodology, programme and cost estimates.
- Coordinate design, drafting, procurement and subcontractors to meet project requirements.
- Act as the interface between engineering, the fabrication workshop and site, including shop drawing review, fabrication scheduling, galvanising and delivery.
- Plan and monitor project schedules in MS Project, and report progress to clients and internal stakeholders.
- Manage commercial aspects of your projects, including cost tracking and forecasting, variations, progress claims, and subcontract and supplier administration.
- Prepare and manage project HSEQ documentation, including management plans, SWMS, ITPs and inspection records, in line with our safety and quality management systems.
- Review subcontractor and supplier QA and HSE documentation, and attend site to monitor performance.
- Resolve technical queries and RFIs, drawing on your structural and foundation knowledge.
- Compile completion and handover documentation, including as-built records.
- Build strong working relationships with clients, subcontractors and suppliers.
What we are looking for
- 5+ years in an engineering role, including at least 3 years on structural, steel or foundation construction projects. A background in either design or construction will be considered.
- A genuine ambition to move into project management, with examples of taking ownership of scope, cost or programme.
- Advanced Excel and MS Project skills.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A sound understanding of HSE and quality management in a construction environment.
Qualifications
Essential
- Bachelor of Civil and/or Structural Engineering (or equivalent qualification with relevant experience).
- Current driver's licence.
- Construction White Card, or the ability to obtain one.
Desirable
- CPEng/NER registration, or working towards it.
- Experience in power transmission, telecommunications or infrastructure projects.
- Working knowledge of AS 3600, AS 4100, AS 2159, AS/NZS 5131 and AS/NZS 1554.
- Formal project management training.
What we offer
- A permanent full-time role with a defined pathway to Project Manager.
- Mentoring from an experienced, engineering-led leadership team.
- Exposure to the full project lifecycle across design, fabrication and construction.
- A stable, family-owned WA business with a strong forward pipeline of work.
- A modern Malaga office with on-site parking, and a regular mix of office and site work.

APPLY NOW

candidates.content_text:
Life at Fulton Hogan is about making the most of opportunities, taking responsibility, and making it happen. We appreciate our peoples' courage, curiosity and unique perspectives, and look to collaborate as much as possible to explore safer, smarter and more efficient ways of working in this rapidly changing world. We don't stand still - there are always opportunities to do more and do better.
- Keen to progress your career? Take full advantage of our tailored training, leadership, and mentoring programs; or leverage our partnerships with industry association such as Engineers Australia, Chartered Accountants, CPA Australia, Infrastructure Sustainability Council, The National Association of Women in Construction, plus many more.
- Looking to enhance your wellbeing? We will encourage you to explore flexible working arrangements where possible. We offer great benefits, including corporate health and fitness programs, health insurance discounts, personal banking support, a range of retailer discounts, up to 18 weeks paid primary carers parental leave and up to 10 days paid secondary carers leave, access to our Employee Assistance Program (including your immediate family), and the option to take more time for yourself throughout the year with our Purchase Leave Policy.
- Want to help us better the communities we live and work in? Our purpose of creating, connecting, and caring for communities is more than a saying to us - it's a way of thinking, working, and living because we're locals too, and seek to give back in ways that strengthen and build resilient communities. We do this because we genuinely care, enjoy what we do, and even manage to have some fun along the way! You'll find us partnering with local and national community groups, like Clontarf Foundation and Black Dog Institute, in addition to indigenous groups and social enterprises, to ensure that our good work positively impacts and brings about sustainable change within our industry.
- Do we offer a 'competitive' salary package? Of course! Speak to our Talent Acquisition or People & Culture team to learn more.
What's on offer?
We're looking for an Estimator to join our Eastern Region Construction (ERC) team in NSW, with the opportunity to work from our Campbelltown, Dapto or Thornton offices.
Reporting to the Pre-Contracts Manager, you'll be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive estimates across a diverse range of civil infrastructure projects for government and private sector clients throughout NSW.
Working as part of a collaborative Pre-Contracts team, you'll contribute to the development of pricing, methodologies and tender submissions while building strong relationships with project teams, subcontractors and suppliers. This role offers the opportunity to further develop your technical and commercial skills while making a meaningful contribution to successful project outcomes.
What you'll do
- Review tender documentation including specifications, drawings and project requirements.
- Assist with site visits to develop construction methodologies, pricing assumptions and identify project risks.
- Prepare quantity take-offs, scopes of work and resource requirements to support estimate development.
- Compile accurate cost estimates using first-principles estimating techniques and historical project data.
- Source and obtain pricing from subcontractors and suppliers, ensuring competitive and compliant submissions.
- Support the preparation and coordination of tender submissions to meet client requirements and deadlines.
- Assist in analysing pricing, identifying risks and opportunities, and contributing to value-driven solutions.
- Work closely with Project Managers, Engineers and Commercial teams to develop practical and competitive bids.
- Contribute to tender reviews and support the handover of successful projects to delivery teams.
- Maintain estimating records, cost databases and lessons learned to support continuous
How you'll connect to the role
Our Civil and Manufacturing team is seeking an Estimator with experience or exposure to civil infrastructure, road construction or related projects. You may come from an estimating, engineering, project coordination or delivery background and be looking to further develop your career within a collaborative pre-contracts environment.
You'll have a sound understanding of construction methodologies and project costs, along with strong attention to detail and the ability to build positive working relationships with stakeholders. We're looking for someone who is eager to learn, enjoys working as part of a team, and takes pride in delivering high-quality outcomes.
Experience with quantity take-offs, cost estimating and estimating software such as Expert Estimation or Benchmark will be highly regarded, however training and development opportunities will be available for the right candidate.
Our people share the same set of values that keep us REAL. Respect, Energy and Effort, Attitude and Leadership encapsulate what we stand for at Fulton Hogan and encourage us to foster a diverse and inclusive culture where we listen to, care for, celebrate, and respect everyone.
We are committed to reconciliation and building and nurturing respectful relationships with First Nations peoples. Through our First Nations Engagement Strategy and Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP), we aim to promote opportunities, cultural understanding and partnerships that celebrate and acknowledge the contributions of Indigenous communities.
If our values resonate with you, please submit an application for the position. If you're not sure that you meet 100% of the selection criteria, that's okay, we would still like to hear from you and potentially discuss how your skills could be utilised at Fulton Hogan.
For over 90 years, Fulton Hogan has been delivering high-quality infrastructure to improve the lives of people every day. Our 10,000+ team works in every kind of weather and environment, creating, connecting, and caring for communities across Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific.

candidates.content_text:
About the role
Loumac Constructions is seeking a practical, detail-focused Building Estimator / Draftsperson who can turn plans into accurate take-offs, complete estimates and clear drawings that procurement and site teams can confidently work from. Working across major government and infrastructure projects, you will detail and estimate awnings, decks, sheds and associated light structural works, with opportunities to contribute to wider building projects. This role involves understanding how things actually get built and taking ownership from initial take-off through procurement, fabrication and construction.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare accurate, itemised material take-offs and detailed cost estimates from plans and specifications, checking dimensions, fixings, stock lengths, cutting allowances and wastage
- Estimate the complete cost of the work, including materials, labour, plant, access, freight, cranage and associated project requirements
- Produce practical, dimensioned 2D drawings, construction details, material schedules and cutting lists, considering constructability, material optimisation and installation methods
- Review supplier quotations, compare scope and pricing, identify exclusions and discrepancies, and raise missing information rather than make unsupported assumptions
- Coordinate procurement requirements, supplier information and staged deliveries, providing clear, complete handovers to procurement, project management and site teams
- Check work, manage revisions and keep drawings, estimates and schedules aligned, liaising professionally with suppliers, consultants, clients and project teams
About you
- At least two years' hands-on experience in both estimating and drafting awnings and decks, or closely related light structural works
- The ability to independently prepare and explain your own take-offs, estimates and drawings, including the quantities, assumptions and checks behind them
- Practical knowledge of construction materials, fixings, installation methods and sequencing, with the ability to spot issues before they become problems on site
- Confidence using AutoCAD or equivalent, Excel and digital take-off or PDF measurement software
- Strong numerical skills, attention to detail, clear communication and a proactive approach to ownership, deadlines and problem-solving

Help shape the North West Growth Area through the design of regional stormwater infrastructure that protects people, property and the environment.

At Blacktown City Council, you are supported by the stability of long term public sector employment, opportunities to build your technical expertise and a team that values collaboration and shared success.

About the role
As a Civil Engineer at Forrest Engineering, you will work across a range of residential and commercial projects from initial assessment through to design, documentation and construction support. The role will involve reviewing project and site information, undertaking engineering calculations and design, preparing drawings and technical documentation, conducting site inspections, and providing engineering support throughout project delivery. You will work closely with senior engineers, clients, architects, builders, certifiers, consultants and contractors to develop practical, compliant and cost-effective engineering solutions.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare and review civil and structural engineering designs, calculations and drawings for residential and commercial projects.
- Design and document foundations, slabs, footings, retaining structures and associated building components.
- Assess site and ground conditions and recommend appropriate engineering and foundation solutions.
- Determine suitable construction methods, materials and engineering requirements in accordance with project specifications.
- Use AutoCAD and relevant engineering analysis and design software to prepare and assess engineering solutions.
- Conduct site inspections to assess construction quality, site conditions and compliance with approved engineering documentation.
- Review structural and construction documentation, including relevant shop drawings, and assist with resolving technical issues.
- Assist with condition assessments, defect investigations and remedial engineering recommendations for existing structures.
- Prepare technical reports and project documentation and assist with estimates, schedules and quality requirements.
- Liaise with clients, builders, contractors, consultants and relevant authorities throughout project delivery, and undertake other related civil engineering duties as required.
About you
- Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Civil Engineering, Bachelor of Civil Engineering, or an equivalent relevant engineering qualification.
- Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in civil, structural or building engineering, preferably within a consulting engineering environment.
- Experience working across residential and/or commercial engineering projects.
- Practical experience with engineering design, calculations, technical documentation and site inspections.
- Experience using CAD, 3D modelling and/or engineering analysis and design software.
- Sound understanding of civil and structural engineering principles, including foundations, slabs, footings, reinforced concrete and retaining structures.
- Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, surveys, geotechnical information and technical specifications.
- Working knowledge of relevant Australian Standards and the National Construction Code.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good attention to detail.
- Current Australian driver licence and willingness to travel to project sites as required.
About us
Forrest Engineering Pty Ltd is a Sydney-based engineering consultancy providing civil and structural engineering services across residential and commercial projects. The practice specialises in housing developments, retaining walls, custom residential design, foundation and slab solutions, and reinforced-concrete design and documentation for commercial projects. The business also undertakes site-specific engineering, Zone-of-Influence assessments, site investigations, forensic engineering and remedial building work, supported by 3D modelling and detailed engineering documentation.
Benefits
- Work with an established engineering consultancy delivering residential and commercial structural and civil engineering projects.
- Gain exposure to a broad range of engineering work including housing developments, retaining walls, custom residential design, commercial concrete structures, site investigations and remedial matters.
- Develop practical engineering capability through design, documentation, site inspections and direct involvement in live projects.
- Work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to cost-effective, constructible engineering solutions.
- Use modern engineering documentation and 3D modelling approaches within a collaborative professional environment.
- Opportunity to further develop civil and structural engineering skills across varied project types.

- Has strong experience in stormwater management and drainage design

De Nada Surveys is a well-established cadastral and multi-disciplined engineering surveying company with a reputation for building strong working relationships with our clients and consistently delivering quality outcomes across a range of projects.
With our head office in Osborne Park, Western Australia, and offices in the South West of WA, Weipa in Queensland, and Darwin and Gove in the Northern Territory, De Nada Surveys has continued to grow and expand our operations across Australia.
We are now looking for an experienced Survey Draftsperson to join our Perth team.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Survey Draftsperson to work closely with our team of Cadastral Surveyors to produce high-quality drawings and plans that accurately reflect information provided.
The successful applicant will be responsible for translating field data into legally compliant cadastral plans. Your primary responsibilities will involve utilising AutoCAD and the NLR-Plan Surveyor Portal to prepare compliant and error-free plans for lodgement at Landgate.
The role will also involve translating field data into accurate and high-quality feature and as-constructed plans that comply with project and client requirements.
Key Responsibilities
- Prepare legally compliant survey plans (Deposited Plans, Strata/Survey-Strata, and Interest Only Plans) using AutoCAD and the NLR Portal.
- Produce feature surveys, as-constructed drawings and miscellaneous drawings as requested.
- Process and present survey data in accordance with project and client requirements.
- Work closely with Surveyors to interpret survey information and resolve drafting issues.
- Review drawings for accuracy, consistency and compliance with project requirements.
- Amend and update drawings based on surveyor and client feedback.
- Assist with the preparation of plans and documentation for a variety of surveying projects.
- Maintain organised project files and drawing records.
- Contribute to improving drafting processes, systems and workflows.
What We Offer
In exchange for your commitment, you will be provided with a supportive and collaborative team environment, an attractive salary and the opportunity to work on a diverse range of Perth's exciting infrastructure, development and resource projects.
You will have the opportunity to further develop your technical drafting skills while working alongside experienced Surveyors and gaining exposure to a broad range of surveying disciplines and projects.
Selection Criteria
- Minimum 2 years' experience in Survey Drafting, with specialised Cadastral experience.
- Advanced working knowledge of AutoCAD, Civil 3D and the Landgate NLR Portal.
- A solid understanding of cadastral surveying principles, land tenure, terminology, and plan interpretation.
- Proven ability to reduce and interpret survey field data, sketches and instructions from Surveyors.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality drawings.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- Ability to adapt to client requirements and respond positively to feedback.
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
- Share our core values of Teamwork, Integrity and Responsibility.
- Have the right to work in Australia.
A qualification in Drafting, Engineering, Surveying or a related discipline will be highly regarded, but is not essential where relevant industry experience can be demonstrated.
Please include a cover letter of no more than one page addressing the above selection criteria.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. This role is being sourced through De Nada Surveys directly and we will not accept applications via external recruitment agencies.
De Nada Surveys is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity in the workplace and encourage Indigenous, female and multicultural applicants to apply.
Applications will be treated with confidence and should be made using the Apply Now link.

candidates.content_text:
About ARQO Building
ARQO Building is a Brisbane-based construction company delivering high-quality projects across five specialised divisions — Signature (architectural builds), Apartments & Interiors, Medical (healthcare fitouts), Projects (commercial), and Priority (fast-turnaround works). We're a growing business built on strong systems and a culture of ownership — where people are trusted to run things properly and given a real path to grow.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Junior Project Coordinator to work alongside our Project Managers and take the admin load off their plate - someone reliable, organised, and proactive who wants to learn the construction industry from the ground up while making a real, immediate difference to how our jobs run.
Our PMs are busier than ever, which is a good problem to have — but it means the admin that keeps jobs moving smoothly (contracts, scheduling, follow-ups, communication) can start to slip. This role exists to make sure it doesn't.
This is a genuine stepping stone into a Project Management or Site Supervision career, with hands-on exposure across multiple project types and direct mentorship from experienced PMs.
What you'll be doing:
- Contract admin support — preparing, issuing, and tracking subcontractor and supplier contracts, chasing signatures and missing paperwork
- Scheduling support — maintaining and updating project programs/trackers, following up trades and suppliers on dates and deliveries
- Communication & follow-ups — chasing quotes, confirmations, RFIs, and variations so nothing sits waiting on someone else's desk
- Document control — keeping site photos, approvals, and job files organised and up to date in our systems
- Site visits — attending site with our PMs to understand progress, issues, and how the job actually comes together
- General PM support — whatever keeps the job moving and takes pressure off the Project Manager's day
About you:
- Studying (or keen to study) construction management, building, or project management — or simply serious about a career in construction
- Highly organised with a genuine ability to follow through and not let things drop
- Confident communicator - comfortable chasing people for information without being pushy
- Computer literate; happy to learn new systems (Buildertrend, ClickUp, Excel)
- Own reliable transport and a current driver's licence (site visits required)
- Prior admin, customer service, or coordination experience is a plus — construction experience is a bonus, not a requirement
What's on offer:
- A genuine career pathway toward Project Management or Site Supervision
- Direct mentorship from experienced PMs across five different divisions of work
- Exposure to a real variety of project types — medical fitouts, apartments, high-end residential, and commercial
- A growing, ambitious business where initiative is noticed and rewarded
candidates.teaser: A Brisbane builder built on strong systems and real career growth. Join us as a Junior Project Coordinator supporting our PMs day to day.

candidates.content_text:
OCU Group is a global infrastructure and energy services business with more than 5,000 people delivering projects that power communities and support the energy transition.
Our Australian and New Zealand operations are growing fast, bringing together great businesses including All Energy Contracting (AEC), Bam Bam, Pilecom and Volta under one group.
All Energy Contracting (AEC) is a leading multidisciplinary construction contractor specialising in renewables and energy infrastructure projects.
We deliver projects across solar, wind, battery energy storage systems (BESS), high voltage connections, substations, balance of plant and associated civil, electrical and mechanical works. 
About the opportunity
We are looking for a Graduate Engineer to join our precontracts team assisting with the building and delivery of tenders on energy infrastructure projects across Australia and New Zealand.
This role will be based in our head office in Hamilton, surrounded by some of the most innovative minds in the energy infrastructure industry, offering a supportive environment of learning and development.
Key Responsibilities
- Support the precontracts team with the analysis of technical information, calculations and project planning on assigned projects.
- Assist in preparing project deliverables, tender documentation, design documentation and specifications in line with company standards to meet client requirements.
- Assume responsibility for minor phases of broader project assignments, delivering them accurately and within the agreed timeframe.
- Build relationships with the project teams and across the wider business to support shared project outcomes.
- Engage in continuous learning, stay current with industry technology trends and contribute to the shared knowledge of the team.
What you’ll bring
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant Engineering discipline (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical or related), completed within last 2 years ideally.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and written communication skills.
- Ability to apply basic theoretical knowledge of engineering principles to analyse, interpret and conclude on standard matters or decisions.
- Good time management skills.
- Desire to succeed as part of a team to achieve shared objectives.
- Desirable: internship, vacation or site experience in construction, utilities, energy or infrastructure.
- Desirable: exposure to substation, HV, transmission, distribution or renewable energy projects.
What we offer
- Be part of something bigger: join an international group operating across the UK, Australia and New Zealand.
- Grow with us: be part of AEC’s expanding presence in Western Australia and across Australia and New Zealand, backed by a strong and growing pipeline of work.
- Work on industry leading projects: contribute to some of Australia and New Zealand’s largest renewable energy and power infrastructure projects.
- Learn from the best: benefit from the combined knowledge, experience and capabilities of specialist businesses across the OCU Group.
- Be part of the energy transition: work in an industry that is helping build a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone is valued. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences We seek to build a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve and seek innovation through varied perspectives. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply and look forward to fostering a supportive workplace together.

candidates.content_text:
About the role
The Project Engineer is responsible for the technical and quality assurance backbone of the project, executing QA requirements, developing and managing ITPs, and driving the identification and close-out of non-conformances. The role supports WH&S and environmental compliance, assists the Project Manager with variation notices and client communication, keeps plans and specifications current, verifies quantities, manages material ordering and scheduling, and monitors subcontractor compliance.
Key responsibilities
- Implement the project quality management plan and ensure QA requirements are understood and applied across the works
- Develop and issue Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for relevant activities, in line with project specifications and standards
- Schedule and attend hold point and witness point inspections, and ensure sign-off documentation is completed and filed correctly
- Maintain accurate and complete QA records to support project close-out and compliance requirements
- Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) where work does not meet specification or approved ITPs
- Investigate the cause of non-conformances and coordinate proposed rectification with the Supervisor and Project Manager
- Review SWMS for technical accuracy and compliance with project and regulatory requirements
- Monitor works for compliance with WH&S and environmental requirements, and report concerns to the Supervisor and Project Manager
- Identify scope changes arising from site conditions, design changes or client instructions
- Monitor and update construction plans, drawings and specifications as revisions are issued
About you
- Technical knowledge of civil construction practices and quality assurance processes
- Experience with Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and quality management systems
- Knowledge of WH&S and environmental compliance requirements
- Ability to prepare technical correspondence and submissions
- Experience with document control and specifications management
- Ability to verify quantities and support cost reporting
- Experience reviewing subcontractor QA documentation and test results
- Strong communication skills for liaison with clients, designers, certifiers and subcontractors
candidates.teaser: Project Engineer responsible for technical and quality assurance on civil construction projects.

Company Description
With over a century of heritage in Australia, BESIX Watpac is a builder deeply ingrained in the local construction landscape. We’re building what matters, with an exciting portfolio of projects across all sectors – from stadiums and venues to complex industrial facilities, hospitals and secure infrastructure, including defence. Our footprint spans Australia and New Zealand, where we continue to deliver projects that leave a lasting legacy in the communities they serve. Our people are the beating heart of what we do, and the passion they bring each day drives our success, to build the best together.
Job Description
BESIX Watpac is seeking a Building Cadet to join our Construction SA division on a part-time basis, working through to our graduate program which will allow you to see all facets of the construction industry including Engineering, Design, Estimating and Safety this is a fantastic opportunity for a university student to secure a role with a Top Tier building contractor.
You will take part of our BESIX Watpac Graduate and Early Career Development Program. This program aims to develop and grow our future leaders. This two-year program builds technical knowledge within the context of an on-the-job environment and provides opportunities to develop professional business and leadership skills. BESIX Watpac Graduates & Cadets gain exposure to various areas of project delivery, and come together for learning workshops, networking, and social events.
This role will be responsible for:
- Assist in preparing cost plans and tenders by reviewing project requirements, compiling tender documentation, and coordinating proposed tender lists.

- Contribute to estimating and project controls activities through quantity take-offs, cost analysis, subcontractor scope reviews, procurement support, and the preparation of tender submissions and budget forecasts.
- Assist with general site duties, office and administration as required.
Qualifications
The incumbent in this role will require:
- Currently studying a university-level degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook and ability and willingness to learn new software packages as required.
- Proven high level of professionalism and work ethic.
- Proven track record and ongoing focus on timeliness, accuracy and punctuality.
Additional Information
Along with a competitive remuneration package and long-term career development opportunities, our employees enjoy access to the following benefits:
- Wellbeing Days - three additional leave days per year.
- Awards and Recognition Program, rewarding employees who bring our values to life.
- Access to a wellbeing program including annual skin checks and flu vaccinations.
- Instant access to Perkbox, giving you a wide variety of perks and benefits, plus curated wellbeing tools to look after your physical and mental health.
- Social events and Family Days.
At BESIX Watpac, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone is valued, supported and respected. By embracing all ages, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, education and appearance, our people feel safe, empowered, and motivated to be their best.  If you’re excited about this role but don’t tick all the boxes, we encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills and believe you would be a great fit with BESIX Watpac.
Join our talented and passionate team delivering once-in-a-generation projects.
BESIX Watpac acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land on which we live and work, and pay respect to the Elders past, present and emerging.

candidates.content_text:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing to our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges, including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? - Career growth with a Tier 1 contractor

HumeLink East is a joint venture between ACCIONA and Genus, delivering 225 kilometres of 500kV transmission line for Transgrid between Bannaby and Wondalga in regional New South Wales. The project includes almost 460 transmission towers and an upgrade to the Bannaby substation, forming a nationally significant addition to the state's electricity transmission network.

As Project Engineer within the Assembly and Erection team, you will support the delivery of transmission tower construction across the HumeLink East alignment. You will work with site teams to coordinate structural assembly, monitor construction sequencing and help resolve delivery issues as towers move from fabrication through to erection. This is hands-on exposure to a major linear infrastructure program, delivered through a joint venture model with ACCIONA and Genus. You will build your technical understanding of structural delivery while contributing to one of the largest transmission projects underway in New South Wales.
Key accountabilities for the position will be:
- Support delivery of tower assembly and erection work packages
- Coordinate structural sequencing between fabrication, transport and site erection
- Monitor quality, safety and compliance during erection activities
- Identify and resolve delivery risks with site and engineering teams
- Liaise with subcontractors and crews to maintain construction progress
- Track progress against program and report on hold points
About You:
- Experience in civil or structural engineering delivery

- Ability to read and interpret structural drawings and specifications
- Strong communication skills across site, technical and commercial teams
- Tertiary qualification in civil or structural engineering, or working towards one
At ACCIONA, we offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where our employees can grow and develop their careers. We provide opportunities for professional development, and our team members are encouraged to bring new ideas and approaches to their work. Our company is dedicated to fostering a culture of inclusiveness and respect where every employee feels valued and supported.
Apply now to join the team delivering HumeLink East.

candidates.content_text:
About the role
Reporting directly to the Pre-Construction Manager and Senior Construction Estimator, the Construction Estimator will assist in preparing accurate cost estimates for landscape construction and civil landscaping projects. The role involves reviewing plans, specifications and tender documentation, undertaking quantity take-offs, obtaining supplier and subcontractor quotations, and supporting tender preparation and project budgeting activities. The position will calculate material, labour, plant and equipment costs, assist in preparing pricing schedules and cost plans, and contribute to the assessment of project scope, tender requirements and estimating risks. The successful applicant will work closely with senior estimating personnel in preparing competitive and commercially sound tenders.
Key responsibilities
- Review and interpret construction drawings, specifications, tender documents, relevant legislation and project information to assist in determining project scope and estimating requirements.
- Prepare quantity take-offs and assist in calculating material, labour, plant, equipment and subcontractor costs required for residential and commercial construction projects.
- Assist in preparing preliminary estimates, detailed cost estimates, pricing schedules, cost plans and tender submissions under the guidance of senior estimating personnel.
- Prepare scopes of work and obtain quotations from suppliers and subcontractors for inclusion in project estimates and tenders.
- Analyse and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations to assist in assessing cost competitiveness and project pricing.
- Liaise with clients, architects, engineers, consultants, suppliers and subcontractors to obtain information relevant to estimating, tendering and project costing activities.
- Attend site inspections, tender briefings, subcontractor meetings and tender review meetings as required to support the estimating process.
- Assist in identifying pricing discrepancies, scope omissions, cost implications and potential estimating risks and report findings to senior estimating staff.
- Revise quantity take-offs, estimates and tender documentation following design amendments, tender clarifications, addenda or changes to project scope.
- Maintain accurate estimating spreadsheets, pricing databases, supplier quotations, tender records and cost documentation.
About you
- A qualification in Construction Management, Building and Construction, Quantity Surveying, Estimating, Civil Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
- Approximately one to three years of experience in construction estimating, quantity take-offs, cost planning, tendering, project administration or a similar construction-related role.
- Demonstrated knowledge of construction materials, building methods, construction documentation and tendering processes.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and estimating software used within the construction industry.
- Ability to accurately analyse plans, specifications and cost information.
- Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with project stakeholders.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet tender deadlines under supervision.
About us
Normark Landscapes Pty Ltd is an established Victorian landscaping and landscape construction company specialising in civil landscaping, landscape design, construction and maintenance solutions. Servicing residential, commercial and public-sector clients throughout Melbourne and regional Victoria, the company delivers high-quality landscape construction works, project delivery and customised maintenance services.
Benefits
- A competitive annual salary of $85,000–$90,000 plus superannuation
- Long-term career progression within a growing business
- Involvement in significant and diverse construction projects
- A professional, supportive and collaborative workplace
- Continuing training and professional development opportunities
- The opportunity to build a career with an established Victorian landscaping and landscape construction company.

About McGloin Baker
McGloin Baker is an engineering, project management, environmental and business advisory consultancy supporting the delivery of disaster recovery and resilience programs, transport and water infrastructure, and major civil projects.
We are a close-knit team built on trust, collaboration and practical project delivery. Our people are supported to take ownership of their work, contribute meaningfully to projects and continue developing their careers.
The opportunity
We are seeking experienced Site Engineers and Project Engineers for upcoming civil infrastructure and disaster recovery projects across the Gold Coast region.
These opportunities will suit engineers with strong construction delivery experience who enjoy working closely with site teams, contractors and project stakeholders.
Experience delivering Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) projects and/or working on Disaster Recovery Funding Arrangements (DRFA) projects will be a major advantage.
About the role
Depending on your experience and project requirements, your responsibilities may include:
- Supporting the planning and delivery of civil construction works
- Coordinating site activities, subcontractors, suppliers and resources
- Monitoring project programs, costs, quality and progress
- Preparing and maintaining project documentation, reports and records
- Reviewing drawings, specifications and technical requirements
- Managing inspections, hold points, quality records and site documentation
- Supporting procurement, variations, progress claims and cost reporting
- Assisting with safety, environmental and quality compliance
- Liaising with clients, contractors, consultants and other project stakeholders
- Identifying project risks and supporting the timely resolution of site issues
About you
You will ideally have:
- A bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline
- Experience as a Site Engineer, Project Engineer or in a similar civil construction role
- Experience delivering civil infrastructure projects
- Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, project controls and site documentation
- The ability to coordinate multiple activities and work effectively within a project delivery team
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- A current Australian driver licence
- Australian working rights
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be highly regarded:
- TMR projects, standards and specifications
- DRFA or natural disaster recovery projects
- Road reconstruction, rehabilitation and associated civil works
- Queensland civil infrastructure projects
- Local or state government infrastructure projects
- Contract administration, quality assurance and project reporting
Why join McGloin Baker?
At McGloin Baker, you will have the opportunity to:
- Contribute to meaningful civil infrastructure and disaster recovery projects
- Work alongside experienced project delivery professionals
- Take ownership of your work and make a genuine contribution
- Build your experience across a range of projects and clients
- Join a supportive, collaborative and growing consultancy
Apply now
If you are a Site Engineer or Project Engineer looking for your next opportunity on the Gold Coast, we would like to hear from you.
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant project experience, including any TMR or DRFA experience.
Applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples are encouraged. Veterans and candidates with Defence experience are also welcomed.

Join Delta for your Summer Internship!

At Delta we have a number of summer internships available for university students from first year right through to final year. We have opportunities available for Mechanical Engineering students. However, we would consider any of the following disciplines:
- Mechanical Engineering
- Electrical Engineering
- Chemical Engineering
- Mechatronics Engineering
About Us:
 Delta is a major Australian energy company, supplying safe and reliable electricity to power hundreds of thousands of Australian homes and businesses.
 Vales Point is a dynamic coal-fired power station delivering a dependable supply of 24-hour baseload electricity. Situated on the stunning NSW Central Coast, it boasts an impressive installed capacity of approximately 1,320 megawatts. In a move towards sustainability, a portion of Vales Point's coal supply is co-fired with biomass, integrating renewable fuel into our energy production.
 At Delta, you will contribute to driving our culture and drive our purpose of providing energy safely, reliably, and responsibly, by empowering our people and respecting the communities and environment in which we operate.
 About You:
 Currently studying a Bachelor's degree and you're ready to put theory into practice and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, large-scale industrial environment. Students studying Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Mechatronics Engineering are encouraged to apply.
 With a proactive and solutions-focused approach, you'll bring strong attention to detail, organisation and a willingness to take ownership of your work. Good communication comes naturally, along with an ability to build positive working relationships with people across the business.
 Most importantly, you'll have a genuine interest in your chosen discipline, a willingness to learn and a desire to continue building your skills and experience as you develop your engineering career.
 Delta's Summer Internship Program:
- 12 week paid internship program during summer university break (commencing early December 2025)
- Competitive base hourly rate of $39.33 to $44.50 plus weekly location allowance and an impressive 14% superannuation
- 35 hour work week
- Work within our Assets, Maintenance and Operations teams at our Vales Point Power Station alongside highly skilled Engineers, Tradespeople and Operators
- Gain exposure to a range of interesting projects and develop your skills in a heavy industry environment
- Utilise our Employee Assistance Program for personal and professional support
- Enjoy working close to home on the beautiful Central Coast NSW
- Potential to join our Graduate Program
Why Delta?
 At Delta, our values guide everything we do:
 CARE - We are committed to the safety and wellbeing of our people and the long-term success of our business. We foster a supportive and sustainable workplace where the quality of our work consistently meets high standards.
 ACHIEVEMENT - We strive to meet and exceed goals, demonstrating success through results and performance.
 RESPECT - We treat everyone with dignity, value diversity, and foster an environment of inclusion and mutual respect.
 EMPOWERMENT - We give employees the autonomy, resources, and trust to make decisions and take ownership of their work.
 Join us at Delta and be part of a purpose-driven organisation that's powering Australia's energy future.

 For more about Delta, visit our website www.deltapae.com.au
